description: Measures the incumbent comparison artifact (the enhanced FRS) is known not to carry, keyed entity.variable. A target bound through a listed measure may be pruned from BOTH arms of the rule-1 evaluation (microcosm#578 rule 1 on the common surface, microcosm#823); an unlisted unresolvable measure refuses the evaluation rather than pruning. Every entry is a complete approval receipt in the reviewed-exclusion schema, in force from approved_on through expires_on.
